name: Topsec Technologies Group Inc.
summary: Topsec Technologies Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides cybersecurity and intelligent cloud solutions for basic networks, industrial internet, internet of vehicles, and internet of things in China and internationally. It is involved in technical development and consulting, software development and sales, network and information security software development, electronic product sales, and communication equipment sales, as well as the provision of computer systems and technical services.
